info.name: AI Tutor API - V1
info.description: Collection for testing Auth and User Management endpoints with automated Token & User ID extraction.

item.name: Issue 5 - Progress and Streak
item.description: Task 2/3. accessToken is a STUDENT token; adminAccessToken is ADMIN. Cookie jar disabled per request to make negative tests reliable. Data comes from Student, immutable attempts and ledger. Run after login; never send studentId to select another student. Streak updates on successful quiz completion (including 0 XP/retakes), not reads or login.

exec: pm.test("Level formula and recent limit", () => { const s = body.data.summary; pm.expect(s.currentLevel).to.eql(Math.floor(s.totalXp / s.xpPerLevel) + 1); pm.expect(s.xpInCurrentLevel).to.eql(s.totalXp % s.xpPerLevel); pm.expect(s.xpToNextLevel).to.eql(s.xpPerLevel - s.xpInCurrentLevel); pm.expect(body.data.recentQuizzes.length).to.be.at.most(5); });

pm.test("No PII or answers", () => { const forbidden = ["email", "phoneNumber", "studentCode", "parentName", "parentEmail", "passwordHash", "correctOptionKey", "explanation", "answers"]; const walk = o => { if (o && typeof o === "object") Object.keys(o).forEach(k => { pm.expect(forbidden).not.to.include(k); walk(o[k]); }); }; walk(body.data); });

pm.test("Days ascending with no gaps", () => { const days = body.data.dailyActivity; days.forEach((d, i) => { pm.expect(d.quizCount).to.be.at.least(0); pm.expect(d.studyMinutes).to.be.at.least(0); pm.expect(d.xpEarned).to.be.at.least(0); if (i) pm.expect(Date.parse(d.date) - Date.parse(days[i-1].date)).to.eql(86400000); }); });

item.name: Issue 5 - Leaderboard
item.description: Task 4. Cookie auth. Run with a STUDENT accessToken assigned to a real class_id, adminAccessToken, unassignedAccessToken (STUDENT with no class_id), otherClassId and otherStudentId. The runtime verification script prepares these local fixtures. No automatic cookie jar; negative requests cannot accidentally reuse login cookies. No leaderboard cache.

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); const d = b.data;

pm.test("Envelope, scope and timestamp", () => { pm.expect(b.success).to.eql(true); pm.expect(["GLOBAL", "CLASS"]).to.include(d.scope); pm.expect(Number.isNaN(Date.parse(d.generatedAt))).to.eql(false); });

pm.test("Bounded sequential ranks and descending XP", () => { const limit = Number(pm.request.url.query.get("limit") || 20); pm.expect(d.entries.length).to.be.at.most(limit); d.entries.forEach((e,i) => { pm.expect(e.rank).to.eql(i+1); if(i) pm.expect(e.totalXp).to.be.at.most(d.entries[i-1].totalXp); }); });

pm.test("Me rank even outside top", () => { pm.expect(d.me.rank).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(d.me.currentLevel).to.be.at.least(1); if(d.me.rank <= d.entries.length) pm.expect(d.me).to.deep.eql(d.entries[d.me.rank-1]); });
